reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in his #central-random thread. I confirmed the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats and told him I hadn't changed anything, since he said no action was needed.

I made one mistake along the way. My first reply said his #central-team post "still has the old number," but I hadn't looked at that channel. I posted a follow-up in the same thread saying I hadn't checked it. I also suggested he edit that post or add a correction if it's still wrong.

A seat count is account information, not a finance figure, so mentioning it in the channel was fine.
